## Professional Summary
Vraj Patel builds dependable backend services, operational data pipelines, and applied ML systems at CU Boulder. His work pairs practical software engineering with research-scale data processing and reliable long-running workflows.

## Professional Experience

### University of Colorado Boulder - Institute of Behavioral Science
**Systems Integration Engineer (May 2025 - Present)**
- Building an internal FastAPI and PostgreSQL ticket-intelligence platform with ML-assisted incident-tag suggestions.
- Built a React, Vite, and Recharts dashboard that identified Tuesday at 10 a.m. as peak ticket volume for staffing analysis.
- Built a PowerShell offboarding tool that reduced each group-membership cleanup run from 15 minutes to under one minute.

### Studio Lab - University of Colorado Boulder
**Research Assistant, Data Engineering and ML (March 2023 - May 2026)**
- Continued the CU Boulder Studio Lab research remotely with the former PI after they moved to Princeton; the collaboration concluded in May 2026.
- Built a cloud-hybrid pipeline for 40+ GB of election speeches and parliamentary records spanning 1981-2024.
- Built resumable Selenium crawlers, AWS transcription and translation workflows, and document-parsing pipelines for large archival datasets.

## Research Writing
- Developing a paper on secure GitHub repository collaboration for work governed by federal data-protection agreements.

### The Data Mine - Purdue University at L3Harris
**Undergraduate Research Assistant, Satellite Telemetry Data Analysis (August 2024 - May 2025)**
